subject: Tours blank after release
body: All tours show a white screen after a deploy.
resolution: Release shipped a shader that failed on older GPUs. Rolled back within 40 minutes, hotfix released the next day; status page updated throughout.

subject: API 500 on special characters in IDs
body: Endpoint fails when the unit ID has a slash.
resolution: IDs were not URL-encoded on our side. Fixed in API 2.13.2; workaround was to URL-encode the ID (%2F) in the path.

subject: CRM sync creating duplicate leads
resolution: Retry logic re-sent leads after slow CRM responses. Added an idempotency key; engineering merged the duplicates for affected clients.

subject: Wrong currency on embedded widget
body: Prices shown in the wrong currency.
resolution: Widget fell back to the browser locale when the project currency was unset. Set the currency per project in Settings > Pricing; code fix made it default to the project currency.

subject: Webhook signatures failing after secret rotation
body: HMAC check fails after rotating the webhook secret.
resolution: Rotation keeps the old secret active for 24 hours; clients must verify against the signature header for the new key version. Shared the verification snippet.

subject: Safari form submit hangs
resolution: Safari blocked a third-party captcha script. Switched to the first-party captcha in release 2.12.

subject: Analytics counts missing
resolution: The analytics ingest job stalled after a schema change. Engineering backfilled the missing days from raw logs; counts restored within 6 hours.

subject: Payment iframe test timing out
body: E2E test times out on payment step.
resolution: Payment sandbox was slow; QA raised the iframe wait to 30s and mocked the gateway in nightly runs. Real-gateway checks moved to a weekly job.

subject: Regression pack before release
resolution: QA runs the regression pack on staging within 1 business day of the request; report shared in #releases with pass/fail per area.

subject: Flaky carousel test
resolution: Replaced fixed sleeps with waiting for the image load event; flake rate dropped from 20% to 0 over 50 runs.

subject: Staging data wiped
resolution: A cleanup job wiped seed data. QA re-ran the seed script and excluded the seed tenant from cleanup.

subject: Unit comparison feature
resolution: Logged on the roadmap board (status: discovery). Client added to the research list for interviews.

subject: Language support request
resolution: Arabic and French are planned for Q2; logged the vote and shared the localisation roadmap page.

subject: Feature removed in update
body: A button disappeared after an update.
resolution: Product confirmed it moved to the '...' menu in the redesign; shared a short GIF and logged the feedback about discoverability.

subject: Quote for new projects
resolution: Account manager sent a quote within 2 business days: onboarding fee per project plus 3D modelling priced by unit types.

subject: Invoice above contract cap
body: Invoice charges more projects than the contract allows.
resolution: Finance issued a corrected invoice and a credit note for the difference within 3 business days.

subject: Unused prepaid hours
body: Client wants money back for unused hours.
resolution: Per contract, unused prepaid hours convert to account credit valid 12 months; refunds need finance manager approval.

subject: Agency partner pricing
resolution: Shared the partner programme (tiered discount from 3+ developer clients) and booked a call with partnerships.

subject: Viewer access for new agent
body: How to add a view-only user.
resolution: Settings > Team > Invite, choose role 'Viewer'. Viewers can open tours and leads but not edit projects.

subject: 2FA lost after phone change
body: Cannot get 2FA codes on a new phone.
resolution: After verifying identity with an account admin, support reset 2FA; user re-enrolled on the new phone. Recommended saving backup codes.

subject: Export leads
resolution: Leads > Filter by date > Export > CSV (opens in Excel). Exports over 50k rows are emailed.

subject: Reset link says expired
resolution: Corporate email scanners were pre-clicking links and using them up. Sent a one-time code reset instead and asked IT to allowlist our domain.

subject: Branding in tours
resolution: Settings > Branding > Upload logo (SVG or PNG, max 2 MB). Applies to all tours within 5 minutes.
